name: DebtLens v1 (self-audit)
tagline: DebtLens v2 analysing the first version of DebtLens
summary: Repository evidence mined from the real v1 git history (29 commits) with the same scanner the CLI uses, plus the findings of the 17 Nov 2026 audit as incidents. The optimiser's plan for this scenario is the v2 rebuild itself.

tour.headline: v1 never deployed its backend, so the live site faked results; deploying a real API unblocks four other fixes.

incidents.title: Live site marks only INC-105 as a regression
incidents.desc: On debtlens-cloud.vercel.app the regression badge appears only on INC-105 whatever incidents exist; new similar incidents are never flagged.
whys: The regression badge is wrong on the live site
The Firestore code path returns a hard-coded regression flag
Regression logic exists only in the FastAPI backend
The FastAPI backend was never deployed, so the browser fakes analytics

incidents.title: Every incident shows DEBT-101 and DEBT-102 as linked debt
incidents.desc: Opening any incident on the live site lists the same two debt items, even for incidents that have no debt.
whys: Linked debts are wrong for every incident
The Firestore and Supabase paths return a fixed list of debt ids
The FastAPI backend was never deployed, so the browser fakes analytics

incidents.title: Anyone on the internet can edit or delete debt items
incidents.desc: Firestore rules allow unauthenticated writes to every collection and deletes on technical_debt_items; the web config ships in the public bundle.
whys: Unauthenticated users can change data
Firestore rules check field types but not who is writing
The deployed app has no authentication layer

incidents.title: Viewer role can approve remediation plans
incidents.desc: Switching the role pill to Viewer still allows every action; no endpoint checks the caller's role.
whys: A viewer could perform lead-only actions
Roles are only a dropdown in the UI
No API endpoint checks the caller's role
The deployed app has no authentication layer

incidents.title: Optimiser leaves 6 hours of a 40-hour budget unused
incidents.desc: The sprint plan dropped DEBT-107 because its prerequisite was not chosen, and nothing replaced it.
whys: Sprint budget was left unused
Items whose prerequisites were not picked were dropped after the DP
The knapsack DP ignores prerequisites and repairs the result afterwards
incidents.fix: Added a transitive-closure check after the DP.
incidents.lesson: Repairing after the DP is still not optimal.

incidents.title: Files of equal length always show identical churn
incidents.desc: Two unrelated files with about 500 lines both show churn 90, although one was never changed.
whys: Churn values look identical for similar-sized files
Churn is computed as 18% of the line count
Git history is never read

incidents.title: Paraphrased incidents not recognised as similar
incidents.desc: 'Webhook callbacks time out' and 'merchant endpoint never acknowledges notifications' scored 0.08 similarity.
whys: Similar incidents were not matched
The 'semantic' score is character n-gram TF-IDF
The MiniLM model promised in the synopsis was never integrated

incidents.title: Demo scenario numbers never change
incidents.desc: FinTech, HealthTech and Supply-chain demo numbers stay the same whatever the data or inputs.
whys: Scenario results do not respond to inputs
Scenario KPIs are hard-coded constants in the page
The FastAPI backend was never deployed, so the browser fakes analytics

incidents.title: Every page waits 1.5 seconds before falling back
incidents.desc: Each request on the live site first tries 127.0.0.1:8000, times out after 1.5 seconds and then falls back to the browser engine.
whys: Pages load slowly on the live site
Each call tries localhost and times out after 1.5 seconds
The FastAPI backend was never deployed, so the browser fakes analytics

incidents.title: Colour theme rewritten 15 times in two weeks
incidents.desc: 18 of 29 commits changed colours or layout, leaving no time for the analytics.
whys: The UI kept changing
Every review led to a new palette
There is no agreed design system
incidents.lesson: Freeze the look; spend time on the engine.

incidents.title: Plan drops prerequisite-dependent items again after a budget change
incidents.desc: At a 60-hour budget the plan again skipped DEBT-107 and left 5 hours unused.
whys: Sprint budget was left unused
Items whose prerequisites were not picked were dropped after the DP
The knapsack DP ignores prerequisites and repairs the result afterwards

incidents.title: Synopsis, code and slides describe three different stacks
incidents.desc: The synopsis says React, FastAPI and PostgreSQL; the code uses SQLite and Firestore; the Demo-1 slides say HTML, Flask and MySQL.
whys: An examiner sees conflicting architectures
Synopsis, code and slides were written separately
There is no single source of truth for the architecture

incidents.title: Demo-1 slides carry speaker notes from another project
incidents.desc: Notes mention intelligent tutoring, BART summaries and quiz generation; the title reads 'MANAGMENT'.
whys: Slides contain wrong speaker notes
The deck was built from an unrelated template
There is no single source of truth for the architecture

debts.title: Deploy a real backend: Flask API on Vercel with TiDB (MySQL)
debts.desc: Replace the four-tier fallback with one API that computes every result.
debts.cause: The FastAPI backend was never deployed, so the browser fakes analytics

debts.title: Server-side authentication and role checks
debts.desc: JWT login and a permission check on every endpoint.
debts.cause: The deployed app has no authentication layer

debts.title: Remove Firestore and its open rules
debts.desc: Delete the client-side database path entirely.
debts.cause: Firestore rules check field types but not who is writing

debts.title: Exact precedence-constrained optimiser
debts.desc: Tree DP / branch and bound that respect prerequisites, verified against brute force.
debts.cause: The knapsack DP ignores prerequisites and repairs the result afterwards

debts.title: Mine churn from real git history
debts.desc: git log --numstat for the CLI, GitHub API for the website.

debts.title: Integrate MiniLM embeddings with a measured evaluation
debts.desc: ONNX MiniLM on CPU and precision@k against TF-IDF.
debts.cause: The MiniLM model promised in the synopsis was never integrated

debts.title: Compute demo scenarios with the real engine
debts.desc: Scenario datasets run through the same analysis as real projects.
debts.cause: Scenario KPIs are hard-coded constants in the page

debts.title: Freeze one design system
debts.desc: One light theme, one accent colour, documented components.
debts.cause: There is no agreed design system

debts.title: Single architecture document behind synopsis, code and slides
debts.desc: One source of truth that the revised synopsis, report and slides are generated from.
debts.cause: There is no single source of truth for the architecture
